mētrŏpŏlītānus , a, um, adj. 1. metropolis,
I.of or belonging to a metropolis, metropolitan (post-class.): “nomen,” Cod. Just. 11, 21, 1 .—Esp. subst.: Mētrŏ-pŏlītānus , i, m., a metropolitan, the bishop of a metropolitan church, Sid. Ep. 7, 9.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
